title: Development and Integration of Sensors and Communications for Advanced Services in 6G
summary: Research program on integrated sensing and communications for advanced 6G services, including reconfigurable intelligent surfaces, heterogeneous computing, intelligent transport, and biomedical interactions.

title: Antenna Prototype Design and Manufacturing
summary: Design and manufacture of antenna prototypes involving active and broadband arrays, miniaturization, metasurfaces, and related antenna technologies.

title: Control Electronics for Radiating Elements
summary: Design of control electronics for radiating elements in antenna arrays, with beamforming and angle-of-arrival applications.

title: Characterization of High-Frequency Interconnects
summary: Characterization of high-frequency transitions and interconnects using network analysis.

title: K-Band Active Antenna Array Study
summary: Study of a K-band active antenna array architecture for satellite-communications applications using active arrays and commercial components.

title: UC3M-SENER Aerospace Chair Collaboration
summary: Collaboration on space technologies including onboard hardware, telecommunications, and support subsystems.

title: Miniaturized Antennas for Planetary Mission Probes
summary: Research, design, and validation of a miniaturized UHF antenna array for a planetary-mission probe.

title: 20-100 MHz Monitoring Antenna with Ferrite Cards
summary: Design and validation of a ferrite-card monitoring antenna covering the 20-100 MHz band.

title: Next-Generation Photonic-Upconversion Radiometers
summary: Development of a silicon-germanium antenna array for integration with a low-noise receiver chain in an Earth-observation radiometer using photonic upconversion.
